packageRules.description: Nothing under ha-gitops-sync/ merges by itself: a change there is a release, so check.yml requires a raised version in its config.yaml and a CHANGELOG.md section for it, which a person adds to Renovate's pull request before merging.

The add-on's base image and the image check.yml runs the tests in move together in one pull request, so the tests always run on the Python and Alpine the add-on ships with; as it touches ha-gitops-sync/, it waits for a person (rule above).
